Here are all the pre-quests needed before the job quest shows up:

Seville Adventure:
1 World most of the good doctor: Spanish & Archeology 3
2 Will Venice (doctor): Spanish & Italian
3 Special read good doctor: Spanish & French
4 Prophecy of Nosuto ~ uradamusu: French & Latin & Art 4
5 Will have the hand of God (physician): Spanish & French
6 Mission of the (doctor) will: Spanish & French
7 Old medicine: Spanish & French
8 The Oath of the (doctor) will: Search 1 & Archeology 3 & French

Seville Maritime
JOB QUEST The medical theory: Surgery 4 & Italian & Spanish

Hope this helps...
